requirements.description: Coverage-first adaptive pair sampling without case expansion
Soft reviewer target and partial contribution flow
Weighted Bradley-Terry ratings, confidence intervals, and connectivity guards
Leaderboard, coverage diagnostics, evidence, and CSV exports
Backward compatibility for all-pairs, adjacent-pairs, and legacy votes
Competition-ranked weak orders with multiple tie tiers and legacy strict-rank compatibility
Stable blinded media cards with desktop and mobile tier editing, merging, splitting, and drag ordering
Tie-adjusted and normalized Borda, fractional first-place credit, pairwise ties, tau-b, relation agreement, and distinction
Tie-aware result, analysis, dimension, pairwise, raw vote, history, and evidence exports with legacy CSV import
Deterministic weak-order regression coverage and desktop/mobile browser verification
